quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 deck, Package Solution: strong sales momentum continued for substrates on rising demand for high-value products and supply of new mobile models, and FC-BGA sales grew with supply expansion. Q3 2026 outlook: strong demand for RF-SiP for new mobile products and FC-CSP for high-performance memory, and timely expansion of FC-BGA production capacity based on global customer partnerships. Key strategies: proactive FC-BGA supply to secure sales growth and high margins through a strategic phased market entry of server-grade products in response to rising AI demand, and timely expansion of the new Vietnam plant backed by customer and product expansion plans; expand premium FC-CSP for APs and respond in time to memory substrates for servers; expand adoption of Cu-Post technology and advanced coreless structures.

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 deck, other divisions' outlook: Optics Solution - Q2 earnings improved year on year on robust long-tail smartphone demand and a better product mix, and auto camera sales increased with expanded supply to key customers; Q3 2026 sales are expected to increase, driven by mass production of new models, and the company plans to expand auto camera supply while advancing robotic vision solutions and preparing for production. Mobility Solution - sales grew across all product segments despite a persistent EV chasm; Q3 2026 outlook is to expand supply of premium products including automotive lighting and communication modules and gradually expand AP module production.
